description: EXAMPLE manifest (template only) for the canonical model artifact contract. Sync with config/model_artifacts.json schema. Do not put secrets or real private URLs in this file.
notes: Do not commit real model binaries to Git.

Use local ignored directories such as models/ and model_zoo/ for restored artifacts.
An active row requires a concrete checksum_sha256 (SHA256 of the complete artifact file bytes).
